name: Six Senses Qing Cheng Mountain
positioning: Spa resort of Chinese-inspired courtyard villas and suites at the gateway to the UNESCO World Heritage site near Dujiangyan, with a spa rooted in Taoism
best_for: Wellness travelers interested in Taoist-inspired spa programs
Families and groups wanting villa space near panda habitat

facts.text: The resort sits at the gateway to the UNESCO World Heritage site at nearby Dujiangyan.
The resort is in Qingcheng Mountain Town, in Dujiangyan, Chengdu, Sichuan.
Its regional architecture and landscaping combine a cultural offering with a contemporary, eco-friendly twist.
The villas and suites draw on a village theme with a palette of natural tones.
The Six Senses Spa offers multi-day wellness programs.
The resort has a main swimming pool billed as a pool for all seasons.
A tennis court and multi-functional sports area are surrounded by Qingcheng Mountain.
There is space for couples, families and entire groups.

highlights.text: Accommodation is Chinese-inspired courtyard villas and suites, some with private pools.
The spa draws on Taoism's healing powers.
Guests can see pandas in their natural habitat just minutes from the resort.
Nearby cultural highlights include ancient towns and the Tianshi Cave, the birthplace of Taoism.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the remote mountain location means longer transfer times.
WhataHotel notes limited dining options in the immediate vicinity outside the resort.
